item.scanner:headline: Acknowledges US-Korea framework for $120B nuclear reactor buildout
item.description:
Acknowledges US-Korea framework for $120B nuclear reactor buildout

Acknowledges a US-Korea framework anticipating a US$120 billion investment by Korea to finance the buildout of Westinghouse reactor technology in the US. The framework contemplates up to eight large nuclear reactors, including six AP1000s and two APR1400s, and a potential equity investment by Korea in Westinghouse. The terms are non-binding and subject to definitive agreements, regulatory approvals, and financing arrangements.

About: Cameco Corporation provides uranium for the generation of electricity in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. It operates in three segments: Uranium, Fuel Services, and Westinghouse. The Uranium segment engages in the exploration for, mining, milling, purchase, and sale of uranium concentrate. Its Fuel Services segment is involved in the refining, conversion, and fabrication of uranium concentrate, as well as purchase and sale of conversion services.

item.description:

Sanofi and Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. announced an expansion of their antibody collaboration, adding four new long-acting antibodies for co-development and co-commercialization. Regeneron will receive an upfront payment of $1 billion from Sanofi, with potential for up to an additional $7 billion in future milestone payments. The companies will share development and commercialization costs and split future profits 50:50 on a global basis.

About: Sanofi engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of therapeutic solutions. It provides immunology and inflammation, rare diseases neurology, oncology, and other vaccines. It also offers poliomyelitis, pertussis, and haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) pediatric vaccines; respiratory syncytial virus protection; hexavalent combination vaccines that includes hepatitis A, typhoid, yellow fever, and rabies vaccines; and Fluzone, a flu vaccine.
